mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines by >0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.2% signals robust consumer demand and housing market strength, jointly driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through revenue expectation upgrades.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both rise > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST rise >0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% monthly signals manufacturing sector expansion, driving corporate capital expenditure and profit growth, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.0% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) consistently above its 12-month moving average signals sustained consumer demand strength, directly supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS remains above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.0% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that trigger Federal Reserve monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.3 percentage points and nonfarm payrolls increase exceeding 50,000 monthly signals rapid labor market improvement, jointly boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.3pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls >0.3pp and PAYEMS rises >50k MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production growth below 0.5% monthly signals manufacturing slowdown, indicating weakening corporate demand and potential earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth falls below 0.5% MoM.
